name: disj_embedding
stmt:
theorem disj_embedding (c₁ c₂ : LinearConstraint) (x : Int) :
    ConstraintSat c₁ x ∨ ConstraintSat c₂ x ↔
      NeuronOut (convert c₁) x * NeuronOut (convert c₂) x = 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with h₁ | h₂
    · have z₁ : NeuronOut (convert c₁) x = 0 := (convert_preserves_semantics c₁ x).mp h₁
      simp [z₁]
    · have z₂ : NeuronOut (convert c₂) x = 0 := (convert_preserves_semantics c₂ x).mp h₂
      simp [z₂]
  · intro h
                                      
    rcases Int.mul_eq_zero.mp h with h₁ | h₂
    · left
      exact (convert_preserves_semantics c₁ x).mpr h₁
    · right
      exact (convert_preserves_semantics c₂ x).mpr h₂

name: prodOuts
stmt: def prodOuts (ls : List LinearNeuron) (x : Int) : Int
proof: (ls.map (fun l => NeuronOut l x)).foldr (fun a b => a * b) 1

name: prod_eq_zero_iff_exists
stmt:
lemma prod_eq_zero_iff_exists (xs : List Int) :
    xs.foldr (fun a b => a * b) 1 = 0 ↔ ∃ v ∈ xs, v = 0
proof:
by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      simp
  | cons h t ih =>
      constructor
      · intro hz
                                                  
        rcases Int.mul_eq_zero.mp hz with hh | ht
        · exact ⟨h, by simp, hh⟩
        · rcases ih.mp ht with ⟨v, hv, hz⟩
          exact ⟨v, by simp [hv], hz⟩
      · intro hv
        rcases hv with ⟨v, hv, hz⟩
        simp at hv
        rcases hv with hvhead | hvtail
        ·                                     
          have hh : h = 0 := by simpa [hvhead] using hz
          simp [hh]
        · have ht : t.foldr (fun a b => a * b) 1 = 0 := ih.mpr ⟨v, hvtail, hz⟩
          simp [ht]

name: disjN_preserves
stmt:
theorem disjN_preserves (cs : List LinearConstraint) (x : Int) :
    (∃ c ∈ cs, ConstraintSat c x) ↔ prodOuts (cs.map convert) x = 0
proof:
by
  unfold prodOuts
                                                             
  constructor
  · intro hprod
    rcases hprod with ⟨c, hc, hsat⟩
                        
    rw [prod_eq_zero_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨NeuronOut (convert c) x, ?_, ?_⟩
    ·                                                             
      apply List.mem_map.mpr
      refine ⟨convert c, ?_, rfl⟩
      apply List.mem_map.mpr
      exact ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    · exact (convert_preserves_semantics c x).mp hsat
  · intro hprod
                               
    rw [prod_eq_zero_iff_exists] at hprod
    rcases hprod with ⟨out, hout, hzero⟩
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hout with ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hl with ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c, hc, (convert_preserves_semantics c x).mpr hzero⟩

end Lattice

name: le_preserves
stmt: theorem le_preserves (x a : Int) : ConstraintLe x a ↔ LeOut x a ≤ 0
proof:
by
  unfold ConstraintLe LeOut
  constructor <;> omega

name: le_and_ge_iff_eq
stmt: theorem le_and_ge_iff_eq (x a : Int) : x ≤ a ∧ a ≤ x ↔ x = a
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h; omega
  · intro h; omega

name: le_ge_iff_sq_zero
stmt:
theorem le_ge_iff_sq_zero (x a : Int) :
    (LeOut x a ≤ 0 ∧ LeOut a x ≤ 0) ↔ (LeOut x a) ^ 2 = 0
proof:
by
  unfold LeOut
  constructor
  · intro h
    have heq : x = a := by omega
    simp [heq]
  · intro h
    have hz : x - a = 0 := (int_sq_eq_zero_iff (x - a)).mp h
    constructor <;> omega

name: bound_embedding_chain
stmt:
theorem bound_embedding_chain (x a : Int) :
    (ConstraintLe x a ∧ ConstraintLe a x) ↔ (LeOut x a) ^ 2 = 0
proof:
by
                        
  rw [le_preserves, le_preserves]
  exact le_ge_iff_sq_zero x a

name: sq_pos_of_ne
stmt: theorem sq_pos_of_ne (x a : Int) (h : x ≠ a) : 0 < (x - a) ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hz : x - a ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hsq : (x - a) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs
    exact hz ((int_sq_eq_zero_iff (x - a)).mp hs)
                    
  have hn : 0 ≤ (x - a) ^ 2 := int_sq_nonneg (x - a)
  omega

end Lattice

name: LvStmt
stmt:
inductive LvStmt where
  | constraintDecl : String → LvConstraint → String → LvStmt
  | prove : String → LvStmt
  | other : String → LvStmt

name: LvProgram
stmt:
structure LvProgram where
  name : String
  stmts : List LvStmt

name: getConstraints
doc: 从 Lv 程序中提取所有约束声明列表（对应 LvDSL.getConstraints）
proof:
p.stmts.filterMap fun stmt =>
    match stmt with
    | .constraintDecl _ c _ => some c
    | _ => none

name: findProveStmt
doc: 从 Lv 程序中提取 Prove 语句（对应 LvDSL.findProveStmt）
proof:
p.stmts.find? fun stmt =>
    match stmt with
    | .prove _ => true
    | _ => false

name: empty_program_no_constraints
doc: 空程序不含任何约束。证明体 = 定义展开（filterMap 作用于 []）。

name: empty_program_no_prove
doc: 空程序没有 Prove 语句。证明体 = 定义展开（find? 作用于 []）。

name: getConstraints_length_nonneg
doc: 约束列表长度非负。证明体 = Nat.zero_le（不涉及任何定义展开）。
proof:
by
  exact Nat.zero_le _

end lvFormal.Theory.LvDSLPartial
